quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 earnings release segment detail (three months ended June 27, 2026): Analog products, MEMS and Sensors (AM&S) revenue was $1,426 million (+26.0% YoY, mainly Imaging and MEMS) with operating profit up 69.2% to $144 million (10.1% margin vs 7.5%); Embedded Processing (EMP) revenue was $1,147 million (+35.5% YoY, mainly General Purpose MCU) with operating profit up 97.8% to $226 million (19.7% margin vs 13.5%). Year-over-year net sales to OEMs rose 23.3% and to Distribution 33.1% (Distribution 30% of Q2 revenue). Inventory was $3.19 billion, with days sales of inventory at 126 days vs 140 days in Q1 and 166 days a year earlier.
